headline: Executive order directs federal action against human trafficking and the online exploitation of children in the United States.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses federal government efforts on fighting human trafficking and the online sexual exploitation of children inside the United States. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it orders federal agencies to take cannot be described here with confidence.

who_it_affects.group: Victims and survivors of human trafficking
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at federal efforts to address trafficking, which may affect services or protections available to them.
The order targets online child exploitation, which is meant to reduce harm to minors online.
The order directs the executive branch to act on these issues, though the exact duties are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 31, 2020; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
